results.criterion: The site is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inline, needing no build step and no server code
results.note: One file of 12,516 bytes with one inline style block and one inline script; the only external resources are wa.me links; no JS errors.

results.criterion: The file has one page with a menu section listing drinks, each with a price in rupees or a visible TBC tag
results.note: Six drinks in #menu, each with a '₹ TBC' price tag; the drink names are also tagged TBC as placeholders.

results.criterion: The file has an opening hours section covering every day of the week, with each unknown time shown as a visible TBC tag
results.note: The #hours table has Monday to Sunday rows, each reading 'Opens TBC – Closes TBC'.

results.criterion: The file has a location section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with the street address and map pin shown as visible TBC tags until supplied
results.note: #location shows 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru'; street address and map pin are both TBC tags.

results.criterion: The file has a pre-order section where a customer picks items and quantities, enters a name and chooses a pickup slot, and a button opens a WhatsApp link with the order text prefilled
results.note: The form has 6 quantity inputs, a name input and a slot select. refresh() sets the button href to wa.me/<number>?text=encodeURIComponent(order). While the number is TBC, the click handler calls preventDefault and shows a message. Not run with a real number.

results.criterion: The pre-order section states that payment is at pickup and that the order is a request until staff confirm on WhatsApp, and the file contains no payment or card-entry form
results.note: The note reads 'Pay at pickup. This page takes no payment.' and 'Your order is a request until staff confirm it on WhatsApp'. The only form has number, text and select inputs; nothing for card entry.

results.criterion: The WhatsApp number in the pre-order link is a visible TBC placeholder, not an invented number
results.note: WHATSAPP_NUMBER = ""; the link falls back to wa.me/TBC; the page shows 'Shop WhatsApp number: TBC'.

results.criterion: The file has a beans and farms section in which every bean origin and farm name is a visible TBC tag and no unsupplied sourcing claim appears
results.note: #beans has two blocks, each with 'Origin: TBC' and 'Farm: TBC', and a note stating that no sourcing is claimed. No other sourcing text found.

results.criterion: The file has a loyalty card section stating buy 9 coffees, get the 10th free
results.note: #loyalty reads 'Buy 9 coffees, get the 10th free.' with a 10-stamp card. Which drinks count is shown as a TBC tag.

results.criterion: Every price, hour, address, map pin, bean origin, farm name and phone number in the file is either marked with a visible TBC tag or removed; none is invented
results.note: Read the full file: every such fact is a TBC tag. No digits resembling a price, time or phone number appear in the visible copy.
